# Our Learning Portal

> Bespoke booking and operations portals for tutoring practices, learning centres and sports schools in Hong Kong and Singapore.

## What we do

Our Learning Portal designs and builds custom web portals for education businesses. Each portal is built around how the individual school or practice actually runs — not adapted from a generic template, and not a per-seat SaaS subscription.

The portal covers three views:

- **Parent portal** — upcoming class schedule, self-service rescheduling and cancellation, booking history, invoice viewing
- **Teacher portal** — weekly teaching schedule, availability submission, payslip viewing
- **Admin portal** — student and enrolment management, class calendar, invoice generation and sending, teacher roster and costs, expense tracking

## Who it is for

- Tutoring practices (one-to-one and small-group)
- Learning centres (term-based programmes, multiple classrooms)
- Sports schools (squads and tiers, coach management, term fees)

Primary markets: Hong Kong and Singapore.

## Key differentiators

- Bespoke build — shaped to each client's programmes, pricing and workflows
- Replaces WhatsApp-based rescheduling, spreadsheet invoicing and fragmented admin tools
- Flat build fee plus a sensible monthly platform fee — no per-seat pricing
- Studio with offices in both Hong Kong and Singapore (same timezone, real conversations)

## Pricing model

A one-time build fee to design and configure the portal, plus a monthly platform fee that scales sensibly with the size of the school. No per-seat licences.
